entities.summary: 25 Martin Place is a skyscraper in Sydney, Australia. Originally named the 'MLC Centre' for around 45 years after the building owner MLC Limited, and is still commonly referred to by that name. In 2021 the name was removed by its owner, Dexus, which now refers to and markets the building simply by its street address of 25 Martin Place.
